author: NasRGV
quote:
Cutting back on features that were available in previous entries does this game no favors. GTA has always been about freedom and open-world gameplay, about being able to forget about missions and the main story for a while and just go out and cause some fun chaos in the sandbox. You can still do that in this entry, but now you're constantly running into restrictions imposed by the developers.

And don't even get me started on the technical state of the game. The sheer number of bugs in a game like this is honestly appalling, to put it mildly.

The funniest part is that when Cyberpunk went through a similar situation at launch, all those hypocritical critics and Sony themselves were quick to bash CD Projekt RED, even going as far as pulling the game from the PlayStation Store. But now, apparently, it's somehow different
